title: Jennifer Lieber Homicide Case – Body-Worn Camera, 911 and Interview Records (Case closed, sentenced 04/07/2026)

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Minnesota Government Data Practices Act, I hereby request the following records:

Incident date: March 4, 2024, approximately 10:00 p.m.
Individual involved: Jennifer Lynn Lieber (defendant)
Victim: David Joseph Nanovic, age 45
Location: residence in Credit River Township (Prior Lake area), Scott County, Minnesota
Case status: Closed. Jennifer Lieber was convicted by a Scott County jury on January 30, 2026 of second-degree intentional murder and sentenced on April 7, 2026 to 306 months. These are inactive criminal investigative data, public under Minn. Stat. § 13.82, subd. 7, and § 13.825, subd. 2(b).

Specifically, I request:
- All body-worn camera footage from deputies who responded to the welfare-check call at the residence on March 4, 2024, including the initial contact with Jennifer Lieber, the discovery of the victim, and her arrest and transport.
- Any recorded interview/interrogation of Jennifer Lieber.
- The 911 call audio (including the call placed by Stuart Lieber requesting a welfare check) and CAD/dispatch records.
- Squad/in-car camera footage from vehicles involved.
- The incident report, complaint supporting documents and supplemental reports, and the booking photograph.

Please provide video and audio in their original electronic format at the highest available quality, by download link. I understand data identifying the minor child and other not-public data will be redacted; please provide all reasonably segregable data and cite the specific statute for any redaction. If there is a cost, please provide an estimate in advance.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 business days.

Sincerely,

Otabek Tolaganov

Bernadette Feazell

title: Jacob Spray Homicide Case – Body-Worn Camera, Interview and 911 Records (Case closed, sentenced 03/24/2025)

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Washington Public Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

Incident date: March 26, 2024 (evening)
Individual involved: Jacob E. Spray (defendant), arrested March 2024
Victim: Jamie Wilson-Spray, age 25
Location: mobile home on Military Hill, Pullman, Washington
Case status: Closed. Jacob Spray was convicted by a Whitman County jury on January 23, 2025 of first-degree murder and a second felony count, and sentenced on March 24, 2025 to 26 years (Judge Gary Libey, Whitman County Superior Court).

Specifically, I request:
- All body-worn camera footage from Pullman PD officers who conducted the welfare check at the residence on March 26, 2024, located the victim, and detained or arrested Jacob Spray.
- All recorded interviews/interrogations of Jacob Spray.
- All 911 call audio related to the incident, including the call from the person who was on the phone with the victim when the call ended and the call from the defendant's father, and the CAD/dispatch records.
- Any surveillance video collected in the investigation.
- The incident/offense report, probable-cause affidavit and supplemental reports, and the booking photograph.

Please provide video and audio in their original electronic format at the highest available quality, by download link. The criminal case has concluded (RCW 42.56.240); if any portion is withheld, please provide all reasonably segregable portions and an exemption log. Versions previously released to the media or admitted at trial are acceptable.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 5 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Otabek Tolaganov

title: Matthew Pahl Homicide Case – Interview Recordings, Body-Worn Camera and Surveillance Video (Case closed, sentenced 11/2025)

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Wisconsin Open Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

Incident date: August 23, 2022 (victim last seen); body recovered in Waukesha in 2023
Individual involved: Matthew Pahl (defendant), arrested 2024
Victim: Stephanie Pavlons, age 28
Location: Waukesha, Wisconsin
Case status: Closed. Matthew Pahl was convicted of first-degree intentional homicide and hiding a corpse on October 31, 2025 and sentenced to life in prison without release plus 12.5 years on November 11, 2025 (Waukesha County Circuit Court, Judge Ralph Ramirez).

Specifically, I request:
- All recorded interviews/interrogations of Matthew Pahl conducted by Waukesha Police Department investigators (video and audio).
- All body-worn camera footage from officers who responded to the missing-person report, the recovery of the victim's remains, and the arrest of Matthew Pahl.
- The apartment-complex surveillance video obtained by the department showing the victim and the defendant on August 23, 2022, and any other surveillance video collected in the investigation.
- 911 call audio and CAD/dispatch records related to the missing-person report and the recovery of the remains.
- The incident/offense reports, arrest report and criminal complaint supporting documents.
- The booking photograph.

Please provide video in its original electronic format at the highest available quality. If any portion is withheld, please release all reasonably segregable portions and cite the specific statutory basis. Versions previously provided to the media or admitted at trial are acceptable.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 business days.

Sincerely,

Otabek Tolaganov
